name: PropertyEffect
description: Represents a property effect for an AnimationBehavior object.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the creator of the specified object.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object.

properties.name: Property
properties.description: Sets or returns an MsoAnimProperty constant that represents an animation property. Read/write.

properties.name: Points
properties.description: Returns an AnimationPoints object that represents a point in an animation.

properties.name: From
properties.description: Sets or returns a Variant that represents the starting value of an object's property. Read/write.

properties.name: To
properties.description: Sets or returns a Variant that represents the ending value of an object's property. Read/write.
